per_agent.pseudo: A channel of near-one-million subscribers deploys synthetic speech and fabricated evidence against a figure whose body is itself a commodity — endorsements, public appearances, marketable aura — and in a single news cycle that commodity collapses. The instrumentalized figure at the center, a woman already dead, belongs to neither side yet is spoken for by both; she is the purest object in the exchange. The state intervenes not at the moment of reputational ruin but at the moment the ruin is proven financially motivated, revealing whose losses count as crimes.

A voice-master in the great marketplace conjures speeches never uttered and letters never written, binding them with the craft of the age. He knows the truth — that the bond between the star and the dead girl began only after she had crossed the threshold of womanhood — yet he sets the false seal upon his words, for the crowd pays well for outrage. The accused's name darkens; patrons flee; he vanishes from the public stage. But it is an old law that the weaver of false voices shall be seized by the very threads he spun, and the magistrate tears the conjurer's mask away.

A career that once filled stadium billboards went dark for months; endorsements vanished, appearances were canceled, and a reputation built over years collapsed under a flood of screenshots and synthetic voices. Afterward, it was traced back: a content creator behind a channel of nearly a million subscribers had opened an AI audio tool one evening, cloned a voice, and paired it with fabricated message records to dramatize an allegation prosecutors would later say the creator knew to be false.

Police in a major city secure an arrest warrant for the operator of a channel with a large following. The operator allegedly used fabricated audio and manipulated message screenshots to claim that a well-known actor had dated a former co-star while she was underage. Prosecutors say the operator knew the relationship began only when the co-star was an adult but spread the false claims to generate revenue. The accusations had caused the actor to lose advertising deals and cancel public appearances for months.

candidates.title: Internet Famous
candidates.overview: A group of Internet "sensations" compete for a tv show. Parody of the Internet.

candidates.title: Little Voice
candidates.overview: After the death of her father, Little Voice or LV becomes a virtual recluse, never going out and hardly ever saying a word. She just sits in her bedroom listening to her father's collection of old records of Shirley Bassey, Marilyn Monroe and various other famous female singers. But at night time, LV sings, imitating these great singers with surprising accuracy. One night she is overheard by one of her mother's boyfriends, who happens to be a talent agent. He manages to convince her that her talent is special and arranges for her to perform at the local night club, but several problems arise.

candidates.title: This Changes Everything
candidates.overview: An investigative look and analysis of gender disparity in Hollywood, featuring accounts from well-known actors, executives and artists in the Industry.

candidates.title: Eyes of a Stranger
candidates.overview: A TV newswoman catches a pervert watching her sister who cannot see, hear or speak.

candidates.title: One Way
candidates.overview: To cover up his infidelities and protect his upcoming marriage, a star advertiser helps free an accused rapist by giving a false alibi and suffers the brutal revenge of the victim.

candidates.title: Magic Farm
candidates.overview: A misguided American documentary crew working for an edgy media company travels to rural Argentina to profile a local musician, but their ineptitude leads them into the wrong small town. As they collaborate with locals to attempt to fabricate a viral trend, unexpected connections blossom, while a pervasive crisis looms unacknowledged in the background.

candidates.title: AK vs AK
candidates.overview: After a public spat with a movie star,  a disgraced director retaliates by kidnapping the actor's daughter, filming the search for her in real-time.

candidates.title: Herostratus
candidates.overview: When a young poet hires a marketing company to turn his suicide into a mass-media spectacle, he finds that his subversive intentions are quickly diluted into a reactionary gesture.
